name: Custom Emojis
description: Custom emojis are migrating only as their emoji names. Slack does not provide a unique identifier/code for custom emojis via API. Due to this limitation, we are unable to fully recreate them in Teams.

name: Stickers
description: Stickers are currently migrating as Sticker Names.

name: Canva Files
description: Canva files are migrating as .html files. Teams does not natively support Canva file format in this context, so we convert them to HTML during migration.

name: List Files
description: List files are currently migrating as normal text links in channels.

name: Video Transcriptions
description: Video transcriptions are not migrating. They are not available on the Teams side via API.

name: Audio Transcriptions
description: Audio transcriptions are not migrating because they are not available on the Teams side via API.

name: Underlined Text
description: Underlined text is not preserved in migration, they are migrating as normal text.

name: Block Code Messages
description: Block code messages have limitations in migration, they are migrating as normal text

name: Reactions
description: Reactions are not migrated.

name: Saved Messages
description: Migrating as normal messages (no saved state retained). We are not getting any info about who saved that message, we can't post this as saved message to destination.

name: Pinned Messages
description: Migrating as normal messages (pin status not retained). Messages cannot be pinned while a Team or Channel is in migration mode. During migration mode, Microsoft Teams allows importing messages with a custom created DateTime value. Pinning a message is a user-level interactive action and is not part of the historical message import process. Therefore, the Microsoft Graph API blocks this operation during migration mode.

name: User Groups
description: User groups are migrating as Group IDs only. Slack API provides only the group ID, not complete group metadata. Therefore, equivalent groups are not automatically created in Teams.

name: Tagged Channel
description: If a message tags the same channel being migrated, the tag will migrate correctly. If a message tags another channel, it migrates as normal text. This happens when the referenced channel is not available in the destination environment.

name: Direct Messages Replies in DMs
description: Replies are not migrated as threaded replies in Teams DMs. Important note: The Microsoft Graph API for Microsoft Teams chats (DMs) does not support threaded replies, because unlike channel conversations, Teams 1:1 and group chats use a flat message structure means messages cannot be linked to a parent message and replies cannot be represented as threads.

name: Polly
description: Polly content is migrating as plain text only.

name: Workflows
description: Slack workflows are not currently supported in migration.

name: Edited message Tag
description: In Microsoft Teams, the “Edited” label is automatically generated by the platform when a user modifies a message directly within Teams. During migration, while the updated message content can be imported successfully, Microsoft Teams does not provide the capability to programmatically set or preserve the Edited status of a message. As a result, the message content appears in its latest version in the destination channel, but the “Edited” label cannot be retained. This behaviour is due to a platform limitation within Microsoft Teams.

name: Forwarded message
description: At present, forwarded messages are being treated as a migration limitation. The data received from the source platform does not allow us to identify and recreate the message as a true forwarded message in Microsoft Teams. Instead, the content is received in a structured format that classifies it under attachments rather than as a standard message. Due to this data structure, we are currently unable to migrate forwarded messages in their original format. While it may be possible to migrate them as normal messages, this would require additional research into the data structure and corresponding code changes.

name: Files from G-drive
description: For Google Slides, we migrate only the link because the file cannot be downloaded from the Slack side. When attempting to download, the link redirects to Google Slides/Google Sheets, so the actual file content is not accessible for download.

name: Private Channels converted to Standard
description: During migration to Microsoft Teams, all channels are initially created as Standard channels due to a Microsoft Graph API limitation, which also automatically provisions a corresponding SharePoint site with the same name for storing attachments and default permissions including “Everyone in the organization” and a channel-named group; after channel closure and member migration, users gain access via the group, and if required, the channel can be converted to Private by updating visibility and removing the “Everyone in the organization” permission so only group members retain access, while archived channels cannot be created via API and are therefore migrated as Standard channels in the destination team.
